# Zova 1.0.0-rc.3

## Experimental browser package

`zova-wasm` introduces an experimental, asynchronous SQL and binary KV API for
browsers. The real Zova core and bundled SQLite run inside a dedicated worker.
The package includes ESM, TypeScript declarations, the worker, and WebAssembly.

This preview is memory-only: closing the database or leaving the page loses
its contents. It does not provide OPFS persistence, full native API parity,
stable browser API guarantees, or native performance guarantees. Native
`zova-js` and `zova-wasm` remain separate packages with no automatic fallback.

The installed npm tarball is tested with Playwright Chromium in Linux CI before artifact
upload. Prerelease publication uses the `next` npm tag and requires a successful
artifact run from the release commit, including the browser verification job.

Storage format remains 11. No format change or migration is introduced by the
browser package.
